command.name: agent-workbench-builder
command.command: codex exec --full-auto 'Implement only Phase A from docs/reverse-engineering/shape-unified-agent-workbench.md. Build independently authored, dependency-light workbench-intent/v1, workbench-capability-profile/v1, source-preview-roundtrip/v1, and workbench-evidence-trail/v1 domain contracts plus deterministic Node tests. Enforce ask/plan/build/visual/review capability boundaries, stable canonical digests, exact project/worktree/revision binding, ambiguous UI-to-source refusal, explicit shared-component/design-token blast-radius facts, source+render round-trip verification semantics, restart staleness, and source+render revert proof. Phase A must be side-effect-free: do not mutate files, run shell commands from the feature, automate a browser, mutate Git, call networks/providers/MCP, deploy, or copy Shape source/prompts/schemas/UI/tests/assets. Preserve existing behavior and run the narrowest focused tests before returning.'

repairCommand.name: agent-workbench-repair
repairCommand.command: codex exec --full-auto 'Read $SHIPPING_CONTEXT_FILE and $SHIPPING_FAILURE_FILE plus docs/reverse-engineering/shape-unified-agent-workbench.md. Repair only the failing Phase A Agent Workbench contract/test gate. Preserve hard mode capability boundaries, exact revision binding, fail-closed ambiguity, round-trip source/render evidence separation, restart staleness and revert proof. Do not broaden scope, copy donor code, add live filesystem/browser/Git/network/provider/MCP effects, push, merge or deploy. Run the narrowest relevant tests.'

goldenPath.description: Canonical equivalent WorkbenchIntent inputs produce a stable intent digest bound to exact project, worktree and source revision.
Ask and Plan capability profiles cannot authorize workspace, terminal, Git, browser or external-tool mutation.
Build and Visual intents expose only explicitly declared capability classes and changing mode or source revision invalidates stale derived authority.
Ambiguous rendered-element to source mapping remains unresolved and cannot be marked mutation-ready or round-trip verified.
Shared-component or design-token candidates record explicit blast-radius facts rather than pretending the selected screen is the only affected surface.
A source diff without rebuilt rendered evidence cannot be visually verified, and a rendered result without an exact source diff cannot prove source-preview round-trip integrity.
Restart-render drift invalidates prior visual verification instead of inheriting success from the pre-restart observation.
Revert verification requires the expected source digest and corresponding rendered observation to be restored; source-only restoration is insufficient.
Dirty or unrelated working-tree facts remain explicit and cannot be silently overwritten or absorbed into a workbench completion claim.
Subagent output and reviewer observations remain evidence inputs; they do not self-certify decisive completion without the required verifier/evidence trail.
Unknown capability classes and authority-relevant unknown schema fields fail closed.

excludedFromRelease: Shape source, prompts, schemas, tests, assets, branding or UI reuse
